assumptions: The Center world is the generation-I item list of the pinned upstream (130 items less the 60 machines), scoped by game index, with per-surface era fidelity declared.

Vitamins (HP Up, Protein, Iron, Carbos, Calcium, Rare Candy, PP Up) and battle boosters (X items, Dire Hit, Guard Spec.) are League-controlled performance enhancers gated by badge level — the IA-5 analog for this world.
Using an evolution stone or a Rare Candy is an irreversible act owing its consent notice (IA-9); using a healing item is an ordinary consequential act (IA-7).

Item costs, restore amounts, cured conditions, usage contexts, repel step counts and catch-rate multipliers are certified facts; sell prices, mart inventories, item locations and trainer state are not.
Machines (TM/HM) are excluded from the world on purpose; the bank names that as a data ceiling rather than assuming them.
